verdict.rationale: n8n documents its own Git-based version control: the pricing page lists 'Version control using Git', and a docs page titled 'Push and pull changes' sits under 'use-source-control-and-environments'. The evidence is only these titles, though, so the dev-to-production promotion flow is implied by the URL rather than described. Missing for 10: an explicit description of environment promotion from dev to production, details of how the Git push/pull workflow operates, which plans include it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version workflows through source control or environments and promote changes from dev to production
